reason: CodeRabbit exact-head review on frozen PR #570 found a real P1: the local-auxiliary V3 authorization declared a fail-closed pre-implementation anti-drift guard, but the trusted delegated-governance evaluator does not mechanically reject a first implementation head when trusted main has advanced beyond the effective authorization merge. PR #569 already demonstrated the resulting failure mode: a valid tests-only first commit can become non-ancestral to the pull-request base before Stage reaches behavior validation. Repair the owning generic trusted policy rather than weakening the local-auxiliary authorization, routing, or failure-first contract.

triggerEvidence.validP1: The declared pre-implementation anti-drift guard is not consumed by trusted policy, so the first implementation head can be created after trusted main has advanced beyond the authorization merge.
triggerEvidence.priorStageFailure: wp0-route failed before policy/behavior execution because the PR event base was not an ancestor of the tests-only head after concurrent trusted-main advancement.
triggerEvidence.freshTrustedMainCause: PR #571 ordinary-merged an unrelated Windows UAT startup recovery authorization after #570 was created.

policyContract.activation: Prospective and optional. Only a delegated authorization whose implementation.failureFirstCommit contains the new exact first-head trusted-main guard declaration is subject to this additional check. Existing authorizations without the declaration preserve current trusted-main refresh semantics.
requiredSemantics: When the opt-in guard is present and the evaluated implementation head is the unique first implementation descendant of the effective authorization merge, trusted main must still equal that effective authorization merge commit.
If trusted main has advanced before that first implementation head is evaluated, fail closed with a stable delegated-governance reason code before accepting the failure-first head.
The first implementation descendant must still satisfy the existing failure-first single-parent, exact tests-only path/count/digest and production-code-forbidden contracts.

After a valid first failure-first head has been established, existing legitimate fresh-main refresh semantics remain unchanged; the new guard must not globally require trusted main to remain pinned to the authorization merge for later implementation heads.
Authorizations without the new declaration retain existing behavior.
No mutable GitHub API or workflow-owned trust source is introduced; the check uses the existing trusted main head and effective authorization merge already available to the evaluator.
nonGoals: Do not change Stage route ancestry semantics.
Do not remove or weaken the existing unique merge-base trusted-main refresh support.
Do not add candidate-specific branch or path exceptions.
Do not make historical authorizations opt in retroactively.

causalRedMustCover: An opt-in delegated failure-first authorization is ordinary-merged and then trusted main advances on an unrelated commit before the first implementation head; the current evaluator accepts the otherwise-valid first tests-only head.
The same fixture must fail closed after the repair with WP0_DELEGATED_GOVERNANCE_FIRST_HEAD_MAIN_DRIFT.
The exact same first-head fixture passes when trusted main still equals the effective authorization merge.

A later implementation head after a previously valid first failure-first head continues to use the existing trusted-main refresh/unique-merge-base semantics rather than being rejected merely because main advanced later.
An authorization without firstHeadTrustedMainGuard preserves existing behavior.

reviewedCandidates.name: Git ancestry/merge-base plumbing
reviewedCandidates.reason: The evaluator already owns trusted main, authorization merge, first-parent history and exact Git topology. The guard needs no new service, dependency or mutable remote state.

reviewedCandidates.name: Yance delegated governance evaluator
reviewedCandidates.reason: At current main this file owns evaluateTrustedDelegatedGovernanceBranch and resolveFailureFirstCommitProtocol; shared/release/implementationBranchPolicy.js only re-exports/composes that authority, so the repair must modify the current owning evaluator seam.

retireOrAvoid: Do not create a local-auxiliary-only policy engine or branch whitelist.
Do not query mutable GitHub state from the offline trusted evaluator.
Do not alter UAT candidate lineage or artifacts.
Do not add dependencies, workflows, databases or general-purpose policy infrastructure.

mandatoryContracts: The authorization PR itself remains one governance JSON only.
The implementation first commit changes only tests/wp0/implementation-branch-policy.test.js and obtains a fresh causal RED before policy code changes.
The repair changes only shared/release/implementationBranchPolicyLegacy.js plus its existing WP0 contract test.
The opt-in declaration is strict and malformed variants fail closed.
Existing authorizations without the declaration preserve current behavior.
A first failure-first head after trusted-main advancement is rejected before it can be treated as valid RED evidence.
A valid earlier first failure-first head does not make later ordinary trusted-main refreshes invalid.
No workflow, dependency, Product, Model Brain, local-auxiliary runtime, Desktop/Windows UAT candidate, release or promotion behavior is changed.
requiredSequence: one-file authorization proposal from exact fresh main -> applicable governance gates -> independent exact-head review
fresh main anti-drift -> explicit owner authorization -> ordinary two-parent authorization merge
create governance/v21-delegated-first-head-fresh-main-guard-p0 from the exact authorization merge only after a fresh main preflight
first implementation commit changes only tests/wp0/implementation-branch-policy.test.js and captures a fresh causal RED
root-fix implementationBranchPolicyLegacy with the minimal optional first-head trusted-main guard
bind the exact RED evidence on the first policy implementation commit and run exact-head Stage/Layered/ACV2 plus independent review
ordinary two-parent merge the policy repair after explicit owner authorization
recreate the local-auxiliary successor authorization from the repaired fresh main; do not revive stale #570
